svg.aria-label: GridWise on real Energinet data for DK2, 26 to 27 November 2026: plugging in at 17:00 costs 2.74 kr per kWh at 97 g CO2; GridWise charges 02:00 to 05:45 at 1.73 kr and 32 g, saving 40 kr and 2.6 kg CO2 for 40 kWh.
svg.text: Plug in at 17:00, or let GridWise wait until 02:00?
40 kWh at 11 kW, ready by 07:30. Real day-ahead prices and CO2 forecast, DK2, 26 to 27 November 2026.
Waiting saves 40 kr and 2.6 kg CO2: 2.74 to 1.73 kr per kWh, 97 to 32 g CO2.
Spot price only; grid tariff, tax and VAT come on top. Source: Energinet, Energi Data Service.
